title: Mercedes-Benz V 300 Marco Polo
subtitle: 4MATIC · Original Westfalia camper · 08/2019 · Rome, Italy
description:
MLT offers this Mercedes-Benz V 300 Marco Polo 4MATIC directly, without intermediaries. It has an original Westfalia camper conversion, was first registered in August 2019 and has 106,000 km. The asking price is €44,900.

The camper includes an electric pop-up roof with an upper double bed, a kitchen with sink, hob and refrigerator, a rear-seat bed, side awning and Webasto stationary heating. Equipment includes full leather upholstery, navigation, parking cameras and sensors, adaptive cruise control, LED headlights and heated front seats.

Contact our MLT team directly for vehicle details, service documentation, an inspection or purchase arrangements.

Accident history, engine output, emission class and climate-control configuration require confirmation. The available technical records contain differing values; these details can be clarified with our MLT team.
included:
Original Westfalia camper conversion
Electric pop-up roof and upper double bed
Integrated kitchen: sink, hob and refrigerator
Rear seats convert into a bed
Side awning
Webasto stationary heating
Dedicated camper electrics and insulation
